On hrvatska.posta.hr/hr/javna-nabava, alongside the palletised-delivery calls for Zadar, Rijeka, Osijek and Split (the last two ending in 'Odluka o poništenju', cancellation decisions), there are TWO device buys the first pass missed: (1) 'Nabava ručnih terminala za skeniranje paketa za potrebe Paketa24' (handheld parcel-scanning terminals for the Paket24 service), ref 406-03/26-01/242, evidencijski broj 26.7, estimated value EUR 200.000,00 EXCLUDING VAT, published 09/07/2026, bids closed 22/07/2026 10:00, 285 handheld terminals (6-inch, Zebra SE4710 2D imager, USB-C, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, 5G, GMS, 6GB/64GB, 5200mAh) plus 285 charging/data cables and rubber covers — NO award or cancellation decision published, so status unverified; (2) 'Nabava TK uređaja za Proglove' (telecom devices for ProGlove wearable barcode scanners), ref 406-03/26-01/199, evidencijski broj 26.6, estimated value EUR 80.000,00 EXCLUDING VAT, published 20/05/2026, bids closed 08/06/2026, 115 Type-1 devices plus left/right glove mounts and charging stands — an 'Odluka o odabiru' (award decision) AND a 'Zapisnik o pregledu i ocjeni ponuda' ARE published, but both are image-only scans with no text layer, so the winner's name could not be extracted. Both procedures run under Art. 37/344 of the Public Procurement Act as non-sectoral activity, i.e. outside the ZJN. RULEBOOK NOW FINAL: the public consultation on the redrafted 'Pravilnik o provedbi postupaka jednostavne nabave' (simple-procurement rulebook) ran 16/07/2026 to 15/08/2026; the 'Izvješće o provedenom prethodnom savjetovanju' dated 17/08/2026 records that ZERO comments were received, and the final Pravilnik is now published on the same page. Separately, the non-ZJN page carries only the high-bay warehouse automation machine (with four amendments/clarifications). The carried baseline items (technical-protection maintenance in post offices; POS maintenance ref 26.2.83) are still NOT published on HP's own pages — those go through EOJN, so 26.2.83 remains STATUS UNVERIFIED from this route.
source_name: Hrvatska pošta — Javna nabava and Nabava na koju se ne primjenjuje ZJN (own pages) + the Poziv na dostavu ponude and consultation-report PDFs
implies: HP's own page is NOT the pure logistics-automation channel the first pass concluded: it published EUR 280k of rugged mobile scanning/wearable terminal buys in three months, adjacent to Printec's field-device and mobility hardware and to its maintenance/helpdesk attach (both calls require a named authorised service network and fault reporting by phone, e-mail and helpdesk). The newly adopted Pravilnik o provedbi postupaka jednostavne nabave sets the thresholds below which HP buys POS/ATM services with no EOJN notice at all — read it to size the invisible business Printec can only win through direct account contact. Cash and branch technology still does not appear here.
likelihood: Recurring rugged-terminal and wearable-scanner refreshes; next round plausible within 12 months
followup: Read the adopted 'Pravilnik o provedbi postupaka jednostavne nabave' (PDF on hrvatska.posta.hr/hr/javna-nabava) to learn HP's simple-procurement thresholds; ask HP Nabava for the outcome of ref 406-03/26-01/242 (Paket24 handhelds, EUR 200k) and for the winner of ref 406-03/26-01/199 (ProGlove TK devices), and get on the invitation list for the next rugged-terminal round. Resolve POS maintenance ref 26.2.83 via EOJN, not via posta.hr.
